unit: Bounded author-enumerated predicates explicitly required by current clauses; includes conditional computations and U facets. Requirement IDs and case rows are not the denominator; numeric examples are not separate outcomes. Not a frozen whole-product denominator.

route_definitions.X: Self-contained required computation has original-code harness route, using retained X basis for recorded inputs. No public waveform/runtime join follows.
route_definitions.S: Exact source/decision supports bounded static/conditional predicate, retaining unresolved premises. Inventory is not a new S grade or public execution proof.
route_definitions.no-established-route: No complete established route for stated observable/U boundary under ADR0003 in this packet. Missing static joins may later be investigated; not proof of impossibility.

grade_policy: No new grades. Preserve12 X computation case IDs,11 conditional render IDs,10 U IDs,one withdrawn ID. MG032-036 song-time U and MG029 load U stay ungraded.

outcomes.outcome: Each eligible track has one mixer stage after its ordered device chain; instantiated source-to-stage path.
Mixer has one main output and one send per T1 return; local port construction.
T1 fixture targets Main; main physical target does not change the defined rendered signal.
Send and SendsPre indices correspond to return list order.
Selected 12-bit SendsPre reader rejects a thirteenth entry; does not establish whole-app opening or global maximum.
Holder-ID gaps and holder/return-count mismatch remain unresolved and excluded.
Deliver main-track main output as the render signal.
Main and send matrices multiply chain-output stereo samples using current gains.
Stated gains act through main/send matrices with no additional intervening gain under T1.
Return send-sum and Main routed-main-sum precede their own device chains.
Stored gain converts to position with curve1 and clamps to [0,1], preserving conversion rounding.
None/curves0-5 apply curve1(position) times crossfade factor before floor.
Transition applies curve1(position times crossfade factor), then floor.
Computed volume gain at/below0.0003199999919 becomes zero.
Conversion/curve arithmetic retains tested exact points and non-roundtrip counterexamples; no general exact roundtrip.
Conditional above-max conversion saturates at1.99526238; opening preservation unestablished.
Conditional below-min/zero/negative conversion yields silence; computed threshold has no general stored-value error bound.
Rendering a document containing out-of-range volume remains U until opening behavior is known.
Main volume follows same conversion with fixture None assignment and c=1.
Main-track A/B assignment and Speaker=false remain excluded U, separately from ordinary tracks.
MainOn scales the complete pan-law matrix including volume, through gates0/1 and intermediate values.
PanMode0/1 maps to Stereo/Split amount.
PanMode amount transitions over fade time.
Ungrouped send matrix combines gain, SendsOn, active bit and pre/post interpolation with P and identity.
At enabled/active unity gates pre-fader ignores track pan, volume, crossfade and volume floor.
Post-fader includes pan law, volume and crossfade via P.
MainOn does not gate sends; SendsOn gates every send.
List-order SendsPre boolean drives pre/post of send k on every track, true->0/false->1.
Pre/post q changes with fade ramp.
Nonzero send conversion uses curve0 with floor, conditional on converter-to-port binding.
Exact stored minimum gives position0/gain0 independently of A4/A7.
EnabledByUser=true implies active for T1 only under A7.
EnabledByUser=false active state/above-min self-send remain U; minimum sends are silent independently.
Actual send-k output reaches k-th return input.
Each sample all addressed outputs sum before destination chain processing.
Selected send adds binary64 products; destination converts total to float32.
Main outputs are float32.
Main-bus order/intermediate precision remain U; proposed tolerance does not resolve them.
Return mixer shapes Main output; return sends follow same rules and contribute nothing at minimum.

source.anchor: The main track has no sends

outcomes.outcome: Main has no send outputs (render-output declaration is the shared REQ001 delivery predicate).
No-solo Speaker false/true yields gates0/1 for main and sends.
Public mute suppresses direct Main and pre/post return contributions.
Speaker/BoolEvent change starts MainOn/SendsOn fade at scheduled sample.
SoloSink and loaded Solo/Cue/SoloInPlace select runtime solo types only under A2.
In Solo mode selected tracks become1 and other audio/MIDI/returns initially3.
SoloInPlace restores returns to0 when no return is soloed.
Feeders of soloed track become2.
Previously-muted active senders of soloed return become5.
Downstream nonreturns become2; Main remains0.
Cue gives selected track6 and all others0.
No-solo logic classifies every track0.
Types0/2/6 follow Speaker on both gates;1 ignores Speaker;3 mutes both;4 keeps Main;5 keeps sends.
Public solo-in-place plays selected track and returns, silencing other players.
Public solo without SoloInPlace also mutes returns.
Public soloed-return mix keeps feeder sends and suppresses feeder Main outputs.
Public Main mix in Cue mode equals no-solo mix.
Exclusive-solo preference is separate from set content and irrelevant to defined loaded-set contract.
Solo changes use fade ramps.
Main/prehear solo and routing outside Main remain excluded U.
Gains apply per sample independently of buffer size; actual scheduling remains unjoined.
Positive-length ramp gives linear progression at scheduled samples.
Zero-length or abs(step)<1e-12 sets target immediately.
Producer resends exact target for switch or next automation ramp at end.
Processor slope and gain accumulate in float32.
Main applies current+k*d with first sample advanced.
Send applies current+(k-1)*d before advancing.
Pan law recomputes at shortest running input-ramp end with other inputs extrapolated.
Volume/crossfade evaluate at input-ramp ends with linear gain between.
Control ramp abs(value)<1e-12 reads0.
Fade helper clamp(G,10,4096) has default75 samples independent of sample rate.
MainOn/SendsOn/q/w use fade ramp nodes.
Developer-option override value/lifecycle remain U outside default-G T1.
Crossfade assignment transition lasts0.002s times sample rate.
Automation supplies volume/pan/send/crossfader ramps; unchanged values have none after start under A1.
Settled render convention sets on/q/w targets at sample0; project decision rather than observed Live opening.
Settled convention takes envelope value at start position, while native time mapping remains unknown.
Actual first samples after opening remain U.
Arrangement drives parameters before launch under A8 initial-index premise.
Return/Main always follow Arrangement under A8, no clip slots.
First Session launch disables Arrangement for render remainder; active clip without envelope falls back to Manual.
After Session end/stop Manual applies, Arrangement is not restored by T1 actions.
Short Pan/Speaker/CrossFadeState track envelopes are discarded on load.
One-event Main tempo/time-signature envelopes retained in T11-MIN are exceptions.
Other retained one-event Arrangement envelopes remain U and excluded from grading.
Session envelope start/loop/warp timebase remains U and excluded.
Float event order retained; first time unconditionally replaced with-10000000 beats.
Curved controls other than0.5 produce15 interior Bezier points and16-piece polyline with f64 times/f32 values.
Original Bezier point arithmetic determines curved-segment polyline point values.
Lookup rounds song-beat minus offset to1/3843840 grid; last point<=time wins including coincident points.
Actual Arrangement song-beat to envelope/sample mapping remains U, with no zero-offset premise.
Segment slope uses f32 value subtraction/f64 duration and clamps v0+max(0,offset)*slope.
Equal-valued segment is constant.
No next point holds value; missing nonzero data-step holds instead of interpolating.
Envelope-time polyline trajectory differs from logic evaluator on curved intervals.
Leading-event envelope-time ramp starts at-1e7 rather than lower schema bound.
Bool/Enum current value applies discretely at/after first event; pre-first unspecified.
Below2^31 ramp-length ratio clamps truncated step/abs(slope) to200..65536.
Ratio>=2^31 overflows signed32 truncation to-2^31 and clamps to200.
Step is range/1000,0.001 for positions and inferred0.002 for pan.
Flat segment sends no ramp.
Last ramp shortens to whole samples on line, then holds to point with <=one-step deviation.
New segment begins at each point's sample, whose actual binding remains unresolved.
Stopped value change uses n0 immediate ramp.
Curves/floor evaluate at ramp ends with gain linear between, including the587-sample example.
Nondefault smoothing remains U outside A6; device parameters belong to their specs.
Volume/Send events convert to clamped positions before interpolation conditional on A3 loaded owner.
Pan/split-pan/crossfader preserve stored units on range.
Active envelope value replaces stored Manual.
Engine returns to Manual after envelope ceases to drive.
Override/re-enable and AutomationMode effects remain U, with no manual edits in T1.
